name: Hypotize
description: Growth OS for AI agents through the hosted Hypotize MCP server: idea backlog, experiment pipeline and learning library shared by the team and the agent. The agent checks what the team already tested, writes hypothesis-first ideas, scores them with ICE, PIE or RICE and closes each test with a measured result and a learning. OAuth and a Hypotize account (free plan available) are required. The linked repository holds the public plugin and skills.
author: Hypotize
